“那里根本没毛病。不看了。”顾客把东西收了回去。

可出借的现金不够放这笔款。

按现状，这件东西没有可放款的价值。
sp5.pawn.needs_assay: A material test is needed before I can lend against the claimed gold content.
要先做成色检测，才能按所称含金量放款。
sp5.line.sale.dealer: "Fine. Make it quick. Will you take it at that?"
sp5.line.sale.surprised: "That is more than I expected. Would you buy it?"
sp5.line.sale.plain: "I would rather sell it. Are you interested?"
sp5.line.pawn.sentimental: "I cannot part with it. Could you hold it for me against a loan?"
“我舍不得卖。能不能押在你这儿借点钱？”
sp5.line.pawn.cash: "I need cash, but I want this back. Can I leave it as security?"
“我急用钱，但还想赎回来。能押在这儿吗？”
sp5.line.leave.collector: "Useful. I will keep it in the collection."
sp5.line.leave.plain: "Thanks. I will keep it for now."
sp5.line.finding.dishonest_material: "Plated? Nobody told me that..." The customer looks away.
“镀的？没人跟我说过……”顾客移开了目光。
sp5.line.finding.dishonest: "That was there when I got it. Probably."
“我拿到的时候就这样。大概吧。”
sp5.line.finding.collector: "I had wondered about that. Go on."
sp5.line.finding.urgent: "Is it bad? I just need to know what it is worth."
“严重吗？我只想知道它值多少。”
sp5.line.finding.truthful_material: "It is not solid? I paid for solid gold..."
“不是足金？我可是按足金买的……”

sp5.book.tool.eye: Eye: structural damage, chips and missing parts are visible without tools. Compare with the intact picture at the same spot.
肉眼：结构损伤、缺口和缺件不用仪器就能看到。对照完好图的同一位置。
sp5.book.tool.loupe: Loupe: shows fine scratches, solder seams and stamp edges. It does not tell you what the metal is.
放大镜：看细划痕、焊缝和印记边缘；它看不出金属成分。
sp5.book.tool.assay: Assay: measures the metal. Test before you value gold that shows a different-coloured base.
成色分析仪：测出金属成分。露出异色底材时，先测再估金价。
sp5.book.tool.scale: Scale: compares the real weight with the claim. Weight alone does not prove purity.
电子秤：比较实重与声称重量；重量本身证明不了成色。
sp5.book.tool.uv: UV lamp: helps find fills, dye and restoration edges. A glow, or no glow, is not proof by itself.
紫外灯：帮助发现填充、染色和修补边界。有无荧光都不能单独作证。
sp5.book.tool.jade_light: Jade light: shows cotton and cracks inside an open window. It cannot read a closed skin.
透玉灯：照出开窗内的棉絮和裂隙；照不透未开的皮壳。
sp5.book.tool.lab_report: Laboratory report: the only way to establish a stone's origin or treatment. A probe can only say 'refer for testing'.
实验室报告：唯一能确定宝石来源或处理的依据。筛查笔只能提示“建议送检”。
sp5.book.tool.gem_probe: Gem probe: screens for obvious substitutes. Passing does not confirm natural origin.
宝石筛查笔：筛出明显仿制品；通过不代表天然。
sp5.book.pricing.metals: Pricing: metal value = weight x tested purity x today's rate. Scratches, dents and repairs only reduce workmanship. Example: gold 600 + workmanship 200 = 800; a scratch -40 leaves 760.
计价：金属价值 = 重量 × 实测成色 × 当日价。划痕、凹陷和旧修只扣工艺价。例：金 600 + 工艺 200 = 800；一道划痕扣 40，剩 760。
sp5.book.pricing.jade: Pricing: the tier (dou, nuo, bing) sets the band; cracks and cotton lower condition. A closed skin is priced at the average band until opened.
计价：豆、糯、冰定档；裂和棉降低品相。未开窗的原石按平均档估价。
sp5.book.pricing.jewelry: Pricing: setting metal + workmanship + each real stone, valued separately. A missing stone removes that stone's value only.
计价：镶座金属 + 工艺 + 每颗真实宝石分别计算。缺一颗石只少这颗石的价。
sp5.book.pricing.recovery: Pricing: a lot is worth what it holds at today's rate. Compare repair and resale before recovery.
计价：物料按含量和当日价计算。回收前先比较维修转卖。
sp5.book.pricing.antiques: Pricing: restoration and recut marks remove the collector premium, not the object itself.
计价：修补和重刻只去掉收藏溢价，器物本身仍有价值。
sp5.book.pricing.art: Pricing: print screens and seal mismatches remove the premium; tears and water damage lower condition.
计价：印刷网点和印章不符去掉溢价；撕裂和水渍降低品相。
sp5.book.pricing.electronics: Pricing: working condition sets the resale price; recoverable metal is a separate, smaller floor.
计价：能否正常使用决定转卖价；可回收金属是另一条更低的底线。
sp5.book.pricing.media: Pricing: edition marks set the premium; scratches lower condition.
计价：版本标记决定溢价；划伤降低品相。
sp5.book.pricing.books: Pricing: first editions and real signatures carry the premium; reprints keep only the reading value.
计价：初版和真签名才有溢价；重印本只剩阅读价值。
